audience: operations and support teams that publish service status and incidents on a StatusHub status page

useCases.title: Check which services are down or degraded now
useCases.text: Count the services on a status page by condition: up, degraded or down. Then list the services and read the status history of any service that is not up.

useCases.title: Review past incidents and how long they lasted
useCases.text: List the incidents on a status page, newest first, and filter them by time range. Open one to read its start and end time, then read its updates.

useCases.title: Report uptime for the page or one service
useCases.text: Get the uptime percentage of a whole status page or of one service for a date range of up to 18 months.

useCases.title: Plan around scheduled maintenance
useCases.text: List the planned maintenance events on a status page and open one to read its time window and affected services.

useCases.title: Draft an incident without notifying subscribers
useCases.text: Create an incident with its first update, then post later updates on it. Each one starts as a draft, and subscribers are not notified unless you ask.
